lines.text: You talk only to Playground; every other session reports up the chain.
There are two leads: the Builder runs the builds, and Ops runs ops.
A worker ends when its chore is done; Playground and the leads never close.
Ops scripts replace the runner sessions for the jobs that run all the time.
Every session runs Opus at xhigh effort, with permissions bypassed.
Each PR gets its own reviewer session, which reviews every push until 5/5.
Each UI PR gets a tester session that drives it in a browser.
Small tasks run as A/B tests, to find which way works better.
Seven workers run at full speed; new work stops at 90% of the weekly limit.
Each thing you ask for is its own task.
The Linear ticket check costs $0: a script reads Linear, with no model.
No Linear ticket is filed without your yes, and there are none for Playground.
Playground is classified: nothing about it goes into a guarded org's work.
A message you ask for goes at once, except to a teammate.
